prompt:
Use case: game-sprite. Generate SIX original hand-painted HD Daoist Q short-cape WORLD overlay frames, transparent RGBA, requested1536x1024, three equal columns by two equal rows. Read source phases in image1 row-major and paint exactly ONE corresponding physical cape layer in each cell. NO labels or captions.
The source item ID is 148. Image1 is the exact six source phase/silhouette contract, not a finished style. Image2 is our OWN new inventory identity board (top148/149/150, bottom151/152); use ONLY the matching 148 cape materials/design. Image3 is our own Daoist-child material/style only, DO NOT depict wearer. Images4/5 are confirmed Daoist game style/material only; ignore all background, scenery, text/UI.
Identity: 青岚羽林披: jade/moss-green silk, ivory lining, very fine warm-gold edging and restrained gold cloud-scroll stitching. Simple collar, three main hem lobes.
CRITICAL: This is a torso/back equipment layer already occluded by an invisible wearer. Preserve the actual sparse side silhouettes: do NOT draw a complete garment in the side cells, do NOT fill the large transparent central open area, do NOT invent a body to fill the gap. Short shoulder cape only, never a full-length robe. Source pixel silhouette is structural guidance, redraw all paint in refined rounded game illustration style.
TOP row phases0/1/2: three distinct EDGE-ON L-shaped cape profiles. A slim horizontal collar/shoulder band extends RIGHT from a narrow hanging cape strip at LEFT, leaving most of the cell empty underneath the rightward band. Phase0 almost vertical narrow hanging edge; phase1 leftward billowing diagonal hanging cloth; phase2 intermediate billow. Follow image1 exactly. BOTTOM row phases3/4/5: short BROAD EXTERIOR/BACK of the same cape, three hem lobes, neutral then left-billowed then right-billowed; image1 controls each hem and collar tilt. Do not repeat the front icon six times.
Physical envelope for each separate cell, deviation must <=5%: cell1 sourcePhase0: visible-envelope W:H=19:18=1.05556, rawOffset[36,62]; cell2 sourcePhase1: visible-envelope W:H=26:17=1.52941, rawOffset[29,62]; cell3 sourcePhase2: visible-envelope W:H=23:17=1.35294, rawOffset[32,62]; cell4 sourcePhase3: visible-envelope W:H=26:18=1.44444, rawOffset[37,61]; cell5 sourcePhase4: visible-envelope W:H=32:19=1.68421, rawOffset[32,61]; cell6 sourcePhase5: visible-envelope W:H=32:19=1.68421, rawOffset[36,61]. These are alpha silhouette ratios, NOT cell aspect ratio. Natural repaint matching each source shape; do not stretch or pad with extra paint to meet numbers. Keep each complete physical layer centred in512x512cell with>=48px clear gutter. Sparse profiles can be larger but must retain their L-shaped empty area.
TRANSPARENCY: Real transparent PNG. Alpha=0 everywhere except the PHYSICAL cape cloth, seams and attached metal trim. All empty wearer-occlusion spaces are alpha=0. No background of any color including white/black, no grey source-board field, ground, shadow, haze, fog, ambient glow, bloom, texture rectangle, stars, particles or detached decoration. No humanoid, head, body, mannequin, hanger, pedestal, UI, frame grid, source labels, numbers, words, logos. Clean antialiased physical edges only. Refined silk folds and physical gold stitching remain inside the exact envelope. Keep all six phases materially consistent.
